comment: Firstlight pipeline configuration. Paths are relative to the repository root.

fonts.comment: The first existing file is used for every caption. Put the series font at workspace/brand/title.ttf; the system fonts are fallbacks.

logoComment: PNG raster of the logo for the title card (ffmpeg does not read SVG). Empty: the title card is typographic.

series.comment: Optional kicker line(s) drawn above the episode title on the programmatic title card (used only when cards.titleBg has no file). Leave both empty for a card with just the episode title — no series branding is invented here.

cards.comment: Optional designer card backgrounds: PNG 1920x1080 without text. If a file is missing the card is drawn programmatically.

elevenlabs.comment: Pin one voice for the whole series and never change it mid-way: every episode must sound like the same narrator. The API key comes only from the environment variable named in apiKeyEnv; it is never written to the repository.

detail.comment: A 'detail' shot: the last frame of the clip, larger, with a slow push-in. Extends a long scene without a new generation.

backends.comment: The single adapter switch for the two stages that have more than one implementation. It documents the default and the choices for the UI and for docs/ARCHITECTURE.md; the engine scripts underneath still take their own CLI flags (--host, --model, ...), so switching a roll to another backend never needs a code change — only a different command, or a different default here.

options.gemini: gemini_shots.mjs / flf_keys.mjs — Gemini image-edit API, paid per key, best identity lock via reference sheets
options.klein: klein_keys.py — local ComfyUI, Flux.2 Klein 9B distilled, free, weaker multi-reference consistency
options.manual: ingest_manual_shots.mjs — a human generates the frame in a web UI, the script only intakes and resizes it

options.comfy-pod: flf_batch.mjs --host <runpod-url> — Wan 2.2 FLF2V on a rented GPU, lightx2v 4-step + NAG by default, --full for a slower/cleaner pass
options.comfy-local: flf_batch.mjs --gguf --quant Q5_K_M — the same script and graph, on a local GPU with 16 GB VRAM
options.wavespeed: wavespeed_batch.mjs --model <name> — cloud API (Kling, Seedance, Wan), billed per clip, no GPU to manage
